GRADE 8 SOCIAL STUDIES — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Self- Improvement in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe personality traits for self- understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Improvement completely.
   C. Self- Improvement is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Improvement.

2. About Self- Improvement around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. share goals for self- improvement in social life,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Improvement completely.
   C. Self- Improvement is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Improvement.

3. About Self- Improvement in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe personality traits for self- understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Improvement completely.
   C. Self- Improvement is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Improvement.

5. About Self- Esteem Assessment in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Esteem Assessment completely.
   C. Self- Esteem Assessment is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Esteem Assessment.

6. About Self- Esteem Assessment around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. determine effects of unhealthy self- esteem in day-to- day social lives,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Esteem Assessment completely.
   C. Self- Esteem Assessment is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Esteem Assessment.

7. About Self- Esteem Assessment in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. assess their self- esteem in social interactions,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Esteem Assessment completely.
   C. Self- Esteem Assessment is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Esteem Assessment.

9. About Scientific Theory about Human Origin in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explore scientific theory about human origin,
   B. Learners should ignore Scientific Theory about Human Origin completely.
   C. Scientific Theory about Human Origin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

10. About Scientific Theory about Human Origin around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate changes that took place in humans as a result of evolution,
   B. Learners should ignore Scientific Theory about Human Origin completely.
   C. Scientific Theory about Human Origin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

11. About Scientific Theory about Human Origin in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. draw conclusions on origin of humanity based on the scientific theory,
   B. Learners should ignore Scientific Theory about Human Origin completely.
   C. Scientific Theory about Human Origin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

13. About Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast,
   B. Learners should ignore Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe completely.
   C. Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

14. About Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world,
   B. Learners should ignore Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe completely.
   C. Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

15. About Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast,
   B. Learners should ignore Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe completely.
   C. Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

17. About Trans Saharan Slave Trade in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify factors that led to development of Trans- Saharan slave Trade in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Trans Saharan Slave Trade completely.
   C. Trans Saharan Slave Trade is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

18. About Trans Saharan Slave Trade around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe organisation of Trans-Saharan slave trade in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Trans Saharan Slave Trade completely.
   C. Trans Saharan Slave Trade is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

19. About Trans Saharan Slave Trade in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. outline effects of Trans- Saharan slave trade in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Trans Saharan Slave Trade completely.
   C. Trans Saharan Slave Trade is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

SECTION B: Short Answers
